text:
The Dow Market Happenings For Wednesday, January 24, 2018 Posted by admin on January 24th, 2018 
Dow stocks at 52 week highs include Cisco (CSCO), Home Depot (HD), JPMorgan (JPM), Coca Cola (KO), McDonald’s (MCD), Microsoft (MSFT), Nike (NKE), Travelers (TRV), UnitedHealth (UNH), Visa (V), Verizon (VZ), Wal-Mart (WMT) and Exxon Mobil (XOM). There are no Dow stock 52 week lows. 
The Market 
Premarket today, the Dow was indicated to open up +92 points. 
Tuesday the Dow was down -3.79 (-0.01%) at 26,210.81. 
Year-to-date the Dow is up +6.03%. 
There were 17 Dow stocks up Tuesday. 
The Dow stock winners Tuesday were led by Travelers (TRV) +4.96% and General Electric (GE) +4.45%. 
The Dow stock losers Tuesday were led by Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) -4.26% and Procter & Gamble (PG) -3.09%. 
General Electric (GE) posts $10 billion loss, sales drop as power weakens. See earnings below. 
European stocks are lower and Asian markets ended mostly higher. 
The national average price of gasoline is up one cent at $2.553 per gallon.
